title: Keith Haring: A Symbol of Love
passage: Keith Haring, a symbol of love. Here we have one of Keith Haring's famous paintings. The people in Haring's work never have faces. This is because Keith Haring saw people as different but equal. The picture shows two people holding up a big heart. Why do you think he did this? Well, he wanted to show the power of love and human relationships. When you look at this painting, how do you feel? For me, I feel very happy. Haring used simple pictures to give people joy when they look at his work. Those heavy lines around the heart are called his energy lines, and they were used in all his paintings. They really help you feel the love. Haring painted this picture in 1988. When Haring was thirty, he got very sick, and he died when he was just thirty-one. In his life, his wish was to show people how important love is, and his other pictures of people hugging do just that.

He wanted the people to look sad
